transcript: okay let's talk applicant tracking system what the heck actually is it contrary to popular belief it's not a robot it's really just a tool so recruiters like this guy can easily scan and search up a resume by text you want to make sure that the text can be extracted out of your resume if your resume is extractable this is good news because if a recruiter types in a particular skill or software your resume is going to pop up so you don't need to be scared of ATS systems especially if your resume is properly formatted and if you think your resume isn't there yet you already know where I'm going to tell you to go oh
